dogecoin.text:
Is $doge to $1 still inevitable?
Genuinely curious now because I thought it was inevitable as well but based on recent evidence I’m not so sure anymore 
1) It’s down over 70% from ATH 
2) elon tweets are pretty much the only bullish catalyst but recently we’ve seen his tweets
Inb4 $doge absolutely chad dick candle pumps and I get exposed for the dimwit leftside of the curve person I am.

Lesson is that it pumps only because it’s a meme which has no use. As soon as $doge got some “fundamentals” it starts having real value expectations when there never was/is value. The power of the meme is that it’s a meme. Feel like it loses power in trying to become legitimate.

Wanna share a lesson (I think) I learned:
Bought $doge at around 20-21 cents because I was reading stuff about vitalik working on it, 3ac shilling, cryptunez doge to $3, elon accepting, and everyone saying that it’s inevitable
Only for $shib to melt faces

Everyone talking about $shib money rotating into $doge 
But what if $doge money capitulate into $shib
The flippening has happened $doge in the mud https://t.co/SzEbIZ5Ghc
